title: ShadeMC-QoL
description: A small client-side quality-of-life mod that adds coordinate copying, low-durability warnings, and full-inventory alerts.
body:
# ShadeMC-QoL

A small bundle of quality-of-life improvements for the **ShadeMC** survival server.

Built for **Minecraft 1.21.1** on the **Fabric** mod loader. 100% client-side — works on any server, even vanilla.

---

## Features

- **Copy coordinates to clipboard** — press a key and your current XYZ is copied, ready to paste in chat or Discord
- **Low durability warning** — when your held tool drops below 10% durability, you get a sound and an action-bar alert so you never break a favorite pickaxe by accident
- **Full inventory warning** — get notified the moment your inventory fills up while mining
- Lightweight, **no configuration**, no overhead

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.16.0 or newer
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and place it in your `mods` folder
3. Download **ShadeMC-QoL** from this page and place it in your `mods` folder
4. Launch the game

## Controls

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| **C** | Copy current coordinates to clipboard |

You can rebind the key from `Options → Controls → ShadeMC`.

## About ShadeMC

ShadeMC is a survival Minecraft server. This mod is part of the official ShadeMC client mod pack, but it works perfectly on any server.
